title: Check a structured answer
summary: A structured answer follows a chosen shape, such as JSON with named fields. Parsing checks the shape; separate checks must verify the meaning and facts.
introduction: A structured answer follows a chosen shape, such as JSON with named fields. Parsing checks the shape; separate checks must verify the meaning and facts. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A structured answer follows a chosen shape, such as JSON with named fields. Parsing checks the shape; separate checks must verify the meaning and facts.

blocks.code:
import json
reply = '{"day": "Friday", "room": 4}'
data = json.loads(reply)
print(isinstance(data["room"], int))
blocks.title: Check a structured answer

blocks.text: The output is True. json.loads reads the JSON, and isinstance checks that room is an integer. It does not prove Room 4 is the real meeting place.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Check that day is a string too.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Valid JSON can contain false or unsupported values.
